Remove an entry when the file no longer needs it. Never add an entry to absorb a new violation without a documented test-harness reason.

atlas-client/src/hooks/__tests__/useTime.reason: Manual test renderer. createHookHarness re-implements useState/useRef/useEffect and invokes the production hook from a plain render() helper across simulated renders, so the call site is neither a component nor a custom hook. Switching the helper name to a use-prefix would make every harness.render(...) call site inside a node:test callback look like a hook call and re-trigger the rule. Test-only harness, not product code.
